matchup.note: Concession split by the position that scored, shrunk with 8 games of prior toward last season's profile where there is one and the league average otherwise. A position whose league baseline is under 0.08 goals a game reports null rather than a ratio with no denominator. weight 0.0 means it is measured and reported but does not move a projection. Goalkeepers and defenders are matched on the opponent's attack_index instead, because their points come from clean sheets.
